title: NIT Manipur Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Project Assistant Posts
description: The National Institute of Technology Manipur (NIT Manipur) has released the latest job notification for 2026. Various vacancies have been allotted for Project Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have completed their B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering, or B.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Manipur Notification 2026 .
